name: One Stop Food & Liquor
address: 1207 S. Martin Luther King Jr. Drive

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Mold and dust accumulation was observed in varying amounts throughout the drink cooler. Owner noted the fans were cleaned ~1 month ago and may have contributed to some of the buildup. Spot check will be conducted in 10 days to verify cleaning.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed eggs and turkey bacon stored above the milk in the reach in cooler. Rearrange products to prevent from potential cross contamination.
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towels in the handsink in the bathroom. Provide paper towels.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed several boxes of chips, soda, and other items on the floor on the facility. Store all boxes at least 6 inches off the floor for protection.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1). Observed the seal to be broken of the cooler door #1 on the left side of the store. Repair the seal on the cooler door of #1 on the left side of the store. 2). Observed duct tape on the chest freezer behind the counter. Repair the chest freezer door.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1). Observed the shelves in the coolers around  the facility to be soiled with dust debris. Clean the shelves in the coolers. 2). Observed the door of cooler #5 to be sticky. Clean the door of cooler #5. 
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floors in the walk-in cooler to be soiled with paper, juice, and debris. Clean the floors in the walk-in cooler.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
Four packages of margarine were found in bottom of reach-in cooler with signs of water damage to packaging and margarine.  CORRECTED - all four packages were immediately, voluntarily, discarded.  No source of water could be found.  Make sure to protect food from damage.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the ice cream freezer next to front door has large amount of ice accumulation. Defrost freezer.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the top around doors/tracks of ice cream freezers to be soiled. Clean these non-food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the following floors to be soiled: 1) floors were soiled in walk in cooler under shelving/along walls. 2) Floor soiled in storage room. Clean these floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
